summary: the two book-level fusion sizing controls are given a covariance measured on the mark stream — synchronised per-cycle mark snapshots seeded on one bucket grid of the feed's own clock — because the daily-close covariance they read admits a name only after several sessions in the running feed mode and so covers none of this book, leaving the concentration multiplier and the volatility budget silently no-op while the desk carries a full per-name budget on every name of a one-sided short; one estimator per cycle chosen by coverage, ties to the incumbent, both consumers scale-invariant and one-way so it can only ever shrink the book (ADR-0089)
